# Pitxmail Developer & AI Agent Guide
> Unified, high-reliability transactional email API for Pitacs projects and autonomous agents.

## Quick Facts
- Service: Pitxmail Cloudflare-Native Email Service
- Base URL: https://mail.pitx.uk/api/v1
- Fallback URL: https://pitxmail.pitacsdev.workers.dev/api/v1
- Web Dashboard: https://mail.pitx.uk
- Authentication: Bearer Token (Authorization: Bearer <PITXMAIL_API_KEY>)
- Generate API Keys: https://mail.pitx.uk/api-keys (requires admin login)
- Allowed Senders: Any address ending with @pitx.uk (e.g. orders@pitx.uk, alerts@pitx.uk, noreply@pitx.uk)

## Core API Endpoints

### 1. Send Email
- Method: POST /api/v1/emails
- Headers:
  - Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>
  - Content-Type: application/json
- Request Body Schema:
  {
    "from": "Pitacs Orders <orders@pitx.uk>", // Required: String with @pitx.uk domain
    "to": ["customer@example.com"],             // Required: String or Array of Strings
    "subject": "Order Confirmation",           // Required: String
    "html": "<h1>Order Confirmed</h1>",        // Optional: HTML string
    "text": "Order Confirmed"                  // Optional: Plain text string
  }
- Response (HTTP 200 OK):
  {
    "id": "pm_cf_1795529594819_6ox50x",
    "object": "email",
    "status": "delivered",
    "provider": "cloudflare",
    "error": null,
    "created_at": "2026-11-24T14:13:14.819Z"
  }
- Error Response (HTTP 400 / 422):
  {
    "error": "Error description"
  }

### 2. List Emails
- Method: GET /api/v1/emails?limit=50
- Headers: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>
- Response:
  {
    "data": [
      {
        "id": "pm_cf_...",
        "fromAddress": "orders@pitx.uk",
        "toAddress": "user@example.com",
        "subject": "Order #4829",
        "status": "delivered",
        "createdAt": 1795529594819
      }
    ],
    "count": 1
  }

### 3. Get Email Details & Attempts
- Method: GET /api/v1/emails/:id
- Headers: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>
- Response:
  {
    "message": { "id": "...", "htmlBody": "...", "status": "delivered" },
    "attempts": [ { "attempt_number": 1, "status": "success", "finished_at": 1795529595454 } ]
  }

### 4. Retry Failed Email
- Method: POST /api/v1/emails/:id/retry
- Headers: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>

### 5. Check System Health
- Method: GET /health
- Public endpoint (no auth required)

## Recommended TypeScript Helper for Agent Integration
```typescript
export async function sendEmail({
  to,
  subject,
  html,
  text,
  from = "Pitacs Orders <orders@pitx.uk>",
}: {
  to: string | string[];
  subject: string;
  html: string;
  text?: string;
  from?: string;
}) {
  const res = await fetch("https://mail.pitx.uk/api/v1/emails", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.PITXMAIL_API_KEY}`,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      from,
      to: Array.isArray(to) ? to : [to],
      subject,
      html,
      text,
    }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    throw new Error(err.error || `Dispatch failed: ${res.status}`);
  }
  return res.json();
}
```
